SUBJECT:  RE-ENVISIONING RECREATION PROGRAMMING UPDATE

BACKGROUND

At the March 25, 2019 Recreation Commission Meeting, the Recreation Commissioners moved
to recommend to the City Council to appropriate an amount not-to-exceed $30,000 to secure
an expert consultant to develop and implement a recreation programming survey. The item was
removed from the April 10, 2019 City Council Meeting agenda so that the City Manager could
explore other options. On April 19, 2019, the City Manager signed an agreement with GreenPlay,
LLC to develop and execute a Recreation Needs Assessment survey to assist in gaining
information to develop a recommendation on the future of recreation programming.

GreenPlay distributed two surveys throughout the month of October 2019. One survey was sent
to a random sample of San Marino residents via mail in order to secure a statistically valid survey.
A second survey was opened online for all members of the community to submit responses. Both
surveys closed on October 28, 2019.

DISCUSSION

The results from the Recreation Needs Assessment survey were returned to staff in January
2020. A community meeting was held on January 23, 2020 to present the findings of the survey
to San Marino residents. A presentation will also be given to the City Council at the January 31,
2020 Adjourned Council Meeting. The findings of the survey are presented to the Recreation
Commission to review.

RECOMMENDATION

Staff recommends that the Recreation Commission receive and file this information report.

SUBJECT:  RECREATION BUDGET FY 2019-20: MID-YEAR UPDATE

BACKGROUND

On May 31, 2019, the San Marino City Council amended and adopted the 2019-2020 Fiscal Year
Operating and Capital Budget. The 2019-2020 Fiscal Year Budget, as adopted, is expected to
produce a 75.5% cost recovery for mandated cost recovery programs.

Expenditures

YTD expenditures out of the General Fund (101) totaled $742,466.90 or 44% of the total
Expenditure budget.

YTD expenditures out of the Restricted Funds totaled $120,721.13 or 48% of the total Restricted
Funds Expenditure budget. Restricted Funds are not included in the 70% cost recovery
calculation.

Revenue

YTD revenues into the General Fund (101) totaled $495,676.18 or 39% of the anticipated
revenues the Department is expected to receive this Fiscal Year. We note that revenues are
expected to increase once spring and summer registration begin.

RECOMMENDATION

Staff recommends that the Recreation Commission receive and file this informational report.

SUBJECT:  2020 EVENT AND MEETING CALENDAR

DISCUSSION

The Recreation Commission holds regular meetings the 4th Monday of August, October, March,
April, and May. However, we note that the 4th Monday in May will conflict with Memorial Day. In
addition, several major recreational events and dates are slated to occur throughout 2020. Below
is the current calendar for the Recreation Commission to review.

    January 27, 2020 – Recreation Commission Meeting
    February 6, 2020 – Track Meet registration deadline
    February 20, 2020 – Preschool Open House
    February 28, 2020 – Track Meet
  o Check-In begins at 4:00 PM
  o First event begins at 5:00 PM
    March 7, 2020 – Spring Registration (Residents)
  o Signups begin for Camp Lacy, Freewheelers, and the Fall Preschool Program
    March 10, 2020 – Spring Registration (Non-Residents)
    March 23, 2020 – Recreation Commission Meeting
    April 1, 2020 – Egg Hunt wristband sales begin
    April 11, 2020 – Egg Hunt
  o Gates open at 9:30 AM
  o First hunt begins at 10:00 AM sharp
    April 27, 2020 – Recreation Commission Meeting
    May 2, 2020 – Summer Registration (Residents)
    May 5, 2020 – Summer Registration (Non-Residents)
    May 25, 2020 – Memorial Day Celebration
    May 25, 2020 – Recreation Commission Meeting (Memorial Day)
    July 4, 2020 – Independence Day Celebration and Fireworks Show
     August 2020 – Free Rec Day (date TBD)
    August 24, 2020 – Recreation Commission Meeting
    October 26, 2020 – Recreation Commission Meeting

RECOMMENDATION

Staff recommends that the Recreation Commission review the proposed calendar of events and
select a special meeting date for the month of May.

SUBJECT:  TRACK MEET UPDATE

DISCUSSION

On Friday, February 28, 2020, Recreation will host the 45th Annual San Marino Community Track
and Field Meet at San Marino High School’s track field from 4:00 PM to 9:00 PM. Participants will
be students from various elementary and middle schools within San Marino Unified School
District.

Notices were sent out the week of January 5, 2020 to the community advising those interested
in participating in the Track Meet to register by February 6, 2020.

Medals were purchased this year with a savings of $300 as compared to the cost of medals in
previous years. Final expenditure figures will be presented at the March 23, 2020 Recreation
Commission meeting.

FISCAL IMPACT & PROCUREMENT REVIEW

For this year’s San Marino Community Track and Field Meet, the following was budgeted:

  Account Code  Description  Budgeted Amount
  281-66-4150-0002  Track Meet Contract Services  $2,000
  101-66-4376-0002  Track Meet Materials and Supplies  $215

RECOMMENDATION

Staff recommends that the Recreation Commission receive and file this information report.
